thought.text: Let me verify Vite's module transform pipeline works (real dependency resolution), which tests the app can actually load.

reasoning_content:
The dev server serves the portal. Now let me actually verify the app bootstraps. The best would be to load it in a headless browser. No chromium. Let me try using jsdom to load the page and execute scripts - but jsdom can't handle ES modules and canvas/webgl. That would likely fail for non-real reasons. 

Alternative: I can verify the module graph loads. Let's fetch /src/masterportal.js via vite and see it transforms. Also verify that vite can resolve dependencies by requesting the main module.

Actually the strongest available evidence: the production bundle serves and is syntactically valid; the dev server serves the portal HTML and the vite-transformed module. Let me try to fetch the transformed src/masterportal.js from the dev server to confirm the module pipeline works.

Let me also try jsdom with module support - jsdom doesn't support ESM. Not viable.

Let me check for a headless browser more thoroughly - maybe playwright is installed elsewhere or chromium apt.

Let me just check whether the vite transform of masterportal.js works.
